'''Agent Flynn''' was an [[SI:7]] agent assigned to investigate the island of [[Balor]]. During the course of this mission, he and nine fellow agents were discovered while surveying the perimeter around the [[Croaking Plateau]] and were taken captive. He, along with [[Agent Cherys|Agents Cherys]] and [[Elroy]], were dragged to a cave beneath [[Stormreaver Spire]] to be experimented on, resulting in his body flaking dry as he quickly began to decompose.

==Objective of==
* Must be interacted with for {{questlong|Alliance|30+|To The Darkest Places}}.
